name: Long Term ST Database: Ambulatory Ischemia Monitoring Benchmark
description: The Long Term ST Database is an extensive multi-center benchmark developed by an international collaboration (University of Ljubljana, CNR Institute of Clinical Physiology, and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center/MIT) to evaluate automated Holter monitoring systems during daily activities. The database consists of 86 continuous 2- and 3-lead Holter ECG recordings, each 21 to 24 hours in duration, from 80 subjects with documented ischemic heart disease. The dataset contains comprehensive beat-by-beat annotations and expert clinical consensus labels for over 1,100 ischemic and non-ischemic ST episodes, providing a challenging benchmark for distinguishing true myocardial ischemia from postural shifts and conduction abnormalities.
